purpose: Variant-neutral observations for stable internal diagnostic facts. Candidate type names, enum representation, Serde shape, and wire encoding are not normative.

fixtures.presentation_pair: Two diagnostics with identical machine facts and different human path/message presentation.
fixtures.complete_fact: One internal error diagnostic with semantic classification, test.validator provenance, schema-id primary subject, related-id related subject, and expected_kind=number code-specific fact.
fixtures.renamed_duplicate_pair: Two otherwise equivalent documents whose duplicate schema human key changes while stable schema IDs remain schema-a and schema-b.
fixtures.ordering_pair: Two diagnostics whose stable machine codes sort opposite to their presentation paths.

adapter_rules: Exercise candidate-owned production validation/diagnostic behavior; do not synthesize the expected facts in the adapter.
Translate candidate names and internal types only into the normalized observations above.
Do not require or score candidate-owned JSON/Serde serialization, enum tagging, public DTOs, or wire compatibility.
Record the adapter bytes and assert that it implements no validation, ordering, subject selection, or presentation-exclusion behavior.
